name: @pipeworx/mcp-legiscan

tools.name: search_bills
tools.description: Full-text search US state (and federal) legislation to find out what bills are about a given topic. Searches one state or nationwide (ALL) and returns matching bills with number, title, state, last action, and a LegiScan bill_id you can pass to get_bill. Example: search_bills({ query: "data privacy", state: "CA" })

state.description: 2-letter state abbreviation (e.g. "CA", "TX") or "ALL" to search every state. Default "ALL".

year.description: LegiScan year code: 1 = all years, 2 = current + prior session (default), or a specific year like 2024.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own LegiScan API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: get_bill
tools.description: Get the full detail for a single US legislative bill — status, sponsors (name/party/role), subjects, and links to the bill text. Use the bill_id returned by search_bills. Example: get_bill({ bill_id: 1234567 })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own LegiScan API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List the legislative sessions for a US state (regular and special), with start/end years and session IDs. Useful to scope which session to track bills in. Example: list_sessions({ state: "NY" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own LegiScan API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-legiscan forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the legiscan pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
